title: Google Classroom Gemini Now Open to All Age Groups of Students: From Flashcards to Contextual Tutoring, Assignments Can Be Directly Fed to AI
excerpt: On August 4, Google announced that the Gemini feature in Google Classroom will be available to all K-12 and higher education students of all ages starting Augus
content_html:
On August 4, Google announced that the Gemini feature in Google Classroom will be available to all K-12 and higher education students of all ages starting August 10, 2026, provided that school administrators have granted the necessary permissions.

This release integrates AI directly into the learning workflow of students. Students can convert course materials into interactive learning tools such as flashcards and practice quizzes directly within the Gemini tab in Classroom, and also sync them to the Gemini Notebook to automatically generate study guides and audio summaries.

The most significant addition is the contextual guidance prompts: students can select a specific course and assignment, allowing Gemini to provide targeted support by combining the assignment requirements and syllabus—rather than general conversations, this allows students to directly feed real tasks such as "how should I write this essay this week" into the model, enabling it to offer suggestions based on the course context.

content_html_zh:
8 月 4 日，谷歌宣布，从 2026 年 8 月 10 日开始，谷歌课堂中的 Gemini 功能将向所有年龄段的所有 K-12 和高等教育学生开放，前提是学校管理员已授予必要的权限。

该版本将人工智能直接集成到学生的学习流程中。 学生可以直接在“课堂”的 Gemini 选项卡中将课程材料转换为互动学习工具，例如抽认卡和练习测验，并将它们同步到 Gemini Notebook 以自动生成学习指南和音频摘要。

最重要的补充是情境指导提示：学生可以选择特定的课程和作业，让Gemini结合作业要求和教学大纲提供有针对性的支持——而不是一般的对话，这让学生可以直接将诸如“这周我应该如何写这篇文章”之类的真实任务输入到模型中，使其能够根据课程情境提供建议。
